title: Agents see relevant newsroom talk in their context
description: A newsroom_talk layer in build_context_pack for the ideation, selection, copywriter and editor profiles: threads relevant to the task (vector and concept match, newest first, budget-bounded), each with its date and authors, labelled as editors' discussion, not instructions that override guidelines. Scenario: an idea about AI regulators gets last week's thread about regulator jokes; an unrelated idea gets none. Scenario: a site with no Slack connection gets the same pack as today. The pack hash covers the threads used.
